pulse: The tape was split on 2026-11-24: the S&P 500 slipped -0.34% to 7212.55 and the Nasdaq 100 dropped -1.33% to 26389.92 on a chip-led selloff, while the Dow Jones rose +0.47% to 49826.19 and the Russell 2000 gained +0.44%, helped by broad breadth of 348 advancers versus 153 decliners. Health Technology led sectors at +2.25% (Eli Lilly +2.96%, AbbVie +2.02%) while Electronic Technology was the weakest sector at -2.83%, dragged by NVIDIA -5.56% and Broadcom -3.62%. Volatility spiked with the VIX up +3.61% to 27.58 even as the 10Y yield fell -0.61% to 4.91%, the Dollar Index (DXY) slid -0.49% to 103.80, and WTI Crude climbed +1.52% to $81.39 while Gold eased -0.50%. Among the most-active names, Anthropic (-7.26%), AMD (-7.60%), Micron (-6.96%) and Sandisk (-6.78%) were hit hardest alongside NVIDIA, while Insmed bucked the trend with a +14.34% surge on very heavy relative volume (6.87x).
